meaning.en: Complete cessation of activity or progress.
meaning.vi: Hoàn toàn ngừng hoạt động hoặc tiến trình.
Bất động hoàn toàn; tạm dừng lại.

meaning_vi: sự ngừng lại, sự đứng lại

sentences.en: The little car slowed to a standstill, but Katie continued spinning the tires.

sentences.en: Then gold-mining, after being long at a standstill, began again to make headway.

sentences.en: The fugitives of Orlov's command disordered the on-coming corps of Stakelberg, and the outer flank of the great counterstroke that was to have rolled up Kuroki's thin line came to an entire standstill.
